log.description: Logging configuration for the MongoDB server.

path.description: Absolute path to the log file.

append.description: If true, logs are appended to the existing log file instead of overwriting it.

rotate.description: Log rotation strategy: 'rename' (rename old logs and create new), 'reopen' (reopen log file for rotation).

storage.description: Storage engine and data directory settings.

dbPath.description: Path to the directory where MongoDB stores its data files.

directoryPerDB.description: If true, stores each database’s data in a separate subdirectory under dbPath.

cacheSizeGB.description: WiredTiger storage engine cache size in gigabytes. 0 uses automatic sizing (recommended for production).

blockCompressor.description: Compression algorithm for collection data blocks.

directoryForIndexFiles.description: If true, stores index files in a separate directory under dbPath.

port.description: TCP port on which MongoDB listens for connections.

bindIp.description: List of IP addresses to bind to. Always include 127.0.0.1 for local access.

mode.description: SSL mode: disabled (no TLS), allowSSL (TLS optional), preferSSL (TLS preferred), requireSSL (TLS mandatory).

PEMKeyFile.description: Path to the PEM certificate/key file. Required if SSL enabled.

CAFile.description: Path to the CA certificate file for validating client/server certificates.

allowConnectionsWithoutCertificates.description: If true, clients may connect without providing a certificate (only if ssl.mode ≠ 'requireSSL').

authorization.description: Enable or disable role-based access control (RBAC).

keyFile.description: Path to the key file used for authentication between members of a replica set. Required for replica sets.

fork.description: If true, MongoDB detaches from the controlling terminal and runs as a background daemon.

replication.description: Replica set configuration. Enable only for replicated deployments.

enabled.description: If true, enables replica set mode.

replSetName.description: Name of the replica set. Must match on all members.

oplogSizeMB.description: Size (in MB) of the oplog, which records operations for replication.

sharding.description: Sharding configuration. Enable only for sharded clusters.

clusterRole.description: Cluster role: 'configsvr' (config server), 'shardsvr' (shard server), or empty (standalone).

configDB.description: Connection string to the config servers in the format <replica-set>/host:port[,...]. Required for shard/config servers.

audit.description: Audit logging configuration. Only available in MongoDB Enterprise.

path.description: Path to audit log file (if destination=file).

systemLog.description: Legacy system log settings (superseded by top-level logPath, but included for compatibility).

path.description: Path to the log file (if destination=file).

logAppend.description: If true, append to existing log file on restart.
